waypoints.name: Savannah bus bench
waypoints.notes: The frame story is set at a Savannah bus bench; the film's bench scenes were shot at Chippewa Square.

waypoints.name: Greenbow, Alabama
waypoints.notes: Fictional Greenbow is placed near west-central Alabama for route continuity; this is not a filming-location claim.

waypoints.name: University of Alabama
waypoints.notes: Narrative anchor for Forrest's football scholarship and the schoolhouse-door episode.

waypoints.name: Memphis, Tennessee
waypoints.notes: Forrest visits Jenny at a Memphis club while on leave.

waypoints.name: Vietnam combat zone
waypoints.notes: The film gives Vietnam combat scenes rather than a precise coordinate; this marker uses the Mekong Delta region as a schematic anchor.

waypoints.name: Lincoln Memorial and Reflecting Pool
waypoints.notes: Washington rally location where Forrest and Jenny reunite after the Medal of Honor sequence.

waypoints.name: China ping-pong diplomacy
waypoints.notes: A Beijing marker represents Forrest's China table-tennis tour; the film does not specify an arena.

waypoints.name: New York City
waypoints.notes: Forrest appears on television and spends New Year's Eve with Lieutenant Dan.

waypoints.name: Watergate Hotel
waypoints.notes: Narrative anchor for the Watergate discovery after Forrest meets President Nixon.

waypoints.name: Bayou La Batre
waypoints.notes: Real Alabama fishing community used as Bubba's home and Forrest's shrimping base in the story.

waypoints.name: Gulf shrimping grounds
waypoints.notes: Schematic offshore point for the shrimping montage and Hurricane Carmen sequence.

waypoints.name: Santa Monica Pier
waypoints.notes: West Coast endpoint in the running montage.

waypoints.name: Marshall Point Lighthouse
waypoints.notes: East Coast endpoint in the running montage near Port Clyde, Maine.

waypoints.name: Forrest Gump Point
waypoints.notes: U.S. 163 view north of Monument Valley where Forrest stops running.

paths.title: Greenbow to University of Alabama
paths.notes: The route models Forrest leaving fictional Greenbow for college football in Tuscaloosa.

paths.title: College years to Memphis leave
paths.notes: Forrest's leave visit to Jenny is represented as a direct road move from the Alabama college arc to Memphis.

paths.title: Deployment to Vietnam
paths.notes: The military deployment is schematic: the film cuts from Army service to Vietnam without naming bases or airports.

paths.title: War hero return to Washington
paths.notes: The path compresses Forrest's hospital recovery, Medal of Honor ceremony, and Washington anti-war rally into one return arc.

sourceRefs.label: AFI synopsis: Medal of Honor and rally

paths.title: Ping-pong diplomacy outbound
paths.notes: China is represented by Beijing as a national route anchor; the film does not specify the table-tennis venue.

paths.title: Return celebrity circuit to New York
paths.notes: Forrest's U.S. celebrity return is mapped to New York for the Dick Cavett and Lieutenant Dan scenes.

sourceRefs.label: AFI synopsis: New York with Lieutenant Dan

paths.title: New York to Watergate
paths.notes: This short domestic hop connects the New York sequence with Forrest's Watergate stay.

paths.title: Discharge home to Greenbow
paths.notes: After discharge, Forrest returns to Alabama; the exact travel mode is not important in the film.

sourceRefs.label: AFI synopsis: discharged and returns to Alabama

paths.title: Greenbow to Bubba's shrimping coast
paths.notes: The route follows Forrest's promise to Bubba into the real Alabama shrimping community of Bayou La Batre.

sourceRefs.label: City of Bayou La Batre: seafood coast

paths.title: Shrimping loop through Hurricane Carmen
paths.notes: A compact Gulf loop stands in for the shrimping montage, storm survival, and sudden haul of shrimp after Hurricane Carmen.

sourceRefs.label: Bayou La Batre coastal seafood context

paths.title: Bayou La Batre to Mrs. Gump's house
paths.notes: Forrest rushes home from the boat when he learns his mother is sick.

sourceRefs.label: AFI synopsis: Mrs. Gump is sick

paths.title: First cross-country run to the Pacific
paths.notes: The first running leg is a road-distance estimate from Alabama to the Pacific; the film compresses the route into a montage.

paths.title: Pacific to Atlantic running turn
paths.notes: This leg follows the film's coast-to-coast turn from the Pacific to the Atlantic; its distance is a broad road-route estimate.

sourceRefs.label: AFI production notes: Maine running scenes

paths.title: Three-year running montage to Monument Valley
paths.notes: The route distance intentionally exceeds the endpoint-to-endpoint road distance to represent Forrest's repeated cross-country running before stopping on U.S. 163.

sourceRefs.label: Paramount synopsis: runs across the country for years

paths.title: Run ends and Forrest returns home
paths.notes: After stopping in Monument Valley, Forrest's off-screen return to Alabama is modeled as a road route before Jenny's Savannah letter.

sourceRefs.label: AFI synopsis: Jenny writes to Forrest

paths.title: Jenny's letter to Savannah
paths.notes: Forrest reaches Savannah after Jenny invites him to visit; the exact bus route is not specified.

paths.title: Jenny and Forrest Jr. move to Greenbow
paths.notes: The final return follows Jenny and Forrest Jr. back to Forrest's Alabama home for the wedding, burial, and school-bus ending.

sourceRefs.label: AFI synopsis: Greenbow wedding and final school bus

locationFacts: The frame story begins with Forrest waiting at a bus bench in Savannah.
The bench is a narrative launch point for the flashback route rather than a journey segment.
deltaFacts: No mapped travel starts in this scene.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: The route has not begun; Savannah is used as the storyteller frame.

locationFacts: Forrest's childhood is set in fictional Greenbow, Alabama.
The route treats Greenbow as the home anchor for the rest of Forrest's travels.
deltaFacts: No intercity route segment is assigned to the childhood setup.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: Greenbow is positioned schematically in west-central Alabama.

locationFacts: Forrest's running ability leads to college football at the University of Alabama.
Tuscaloosa is the first named real destination after the Greenbow childhood scenes.
deltaFacts: The route moves from fictional Greenbow to the University of Alabama.
slopeFacts: Surface road movement; no elevation model is applied.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: Short west-central Alabama to Tuscaloosa segment.

locationFacts: Forrest joins the Army after graduation.
Before Vietnam, he visits Jenny at a Memphis club while on leave.
deltaFacts: The mapped route moves from the Alabama college arc to Memphis.
slopeFacts: Surface road movement; no vertical change is modeled.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: The scene points the route northwest from Alabama toward Tennessee.

sourceRefs.label: AFI synopsis: Army and Memphis leave

locationFacts: Forrest and Bubba are sent to fight in Vietnam.
The ambush and rescue sequence is mapped to a schematic Mekong Delta anchor.
deltaFacts: The route leaves the United States for Southeast Asia.
slopeFacts: Long surface-globe air path; no altitude is modeled.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: The military deployment crosses the Pacific through schematic control points.

locationFacts: Forrest returns as a wounded veteran and receives the Medal of Honor.
The Washington rally reunites Forrest and Jenny near the Reflecting Pool.
deltaFacts: The route returns from Vietnam to Washington, D.C.
slopeFacts: Long surface-globe air path; no altitude is modeled.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: The return path crosses the Pacific and continental United States.

sourceRefs.label: AFI synopsis: Medal of Honor and rally

locationFacts: Forrest joins the U.S. table-tennis tour in China.
He then becomes a television celebrity and spends time with Lieutenant Dan in New York.
deltaFacts: The route crosses from Washington to China, then returns to New York.
slopeFacts: Long air-route arcs over the globe; no elevation or depth is modeled.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: Two transcontinental arcs represent the ping-pong diplomacy and celebrity return sequence.

sourceRefs.label: Paramount synopsis: table tennis and celebrity
AFI synopsis: China and New York

locationFacts: Forrest is put up at the Watergate Hotel after meeting President Nixon.
After discharge, the story returns him to Alabama.
deltaFacts: The route moves from New York to Washington, then back to Greenbow.
slopeFacts: Surface-globe domestic travel; no altitude is modeled.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: The chapter closes the military-celebrity loop and returns the route to Alabama.

locationFacts: Forrest uses his endorsement money to begin the Bubba Gump shrimping business.
Bayou La Batre provides the real coastal anchor for the shrimping chapter.
deltaFacts: The route moves from Greenbow to the Alabama Gulf Coast.
slopeFacts: Surface road movement to the coast.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: The route turns south from inland Alabama toward Mobile Bay and the Gulf.

locationFacts: Lieutenant Dan joins Forrest on the shrimp boat.
Hurricane Carmen leaves their boat as a successful survivor in the shrimping business.
deltaFacts: A short Gulf loop represents repeated shrimping trips rather than one literal voyage.
slopeFacts: Surface sea route; no depth movement is modeled.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: The loop leaves and returns to Bayou La Batre through an estimated offshore control point.

sourceRefs.label: AFI synopsis: shrimp boat and hurricane

locationFacts: Forrest learns his mother is ill and rushes back home.
Greenbow becomes the route anchor again after the shrimping success.
deltaFacts: The route returns from Bayou La Batre to Greenbow.
slopeFacts: Surface road return; no vertical change is modeled.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: The path reverses the Alabama Gulf Coast route back inland.

sourceRefs.label: AFI synopsis: Mrs. Gump is sick

locationFacts: Jenny returns to stay with Forrest in Greenbow.
After she leaves, Forrest's next movement begins the running odyssey.
deltaFacts: No new mapped travel occurs until Forrest starts running.
slopeFacts: Stationary surface scene at the home anchor.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: The route holds at Greenbow before the cross-country run.

sourceRefs.label: AFI synopsis: Jenny returns and leaves

locationFacts: Forrest begins running from home after Jenny leaves.
The first major endpoint is the Pacific Ocean at Santa Monica.
deltaFacts: The route estimates the westbound run from Alabama to the Pacific at 3,400 km.
slopeFacts: Surface running route across the southern and southwestern United States.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: The control points route the run through Texas, New Mexico, and Arizona before California.

locationFacts: After reaching the Pacific, Forrest turns around and keeps running.
Marshall Point Lighthouse anchors the Atlantic-side turn in the montage.
deltaFacts: The route estimates the coast-to-coast running leg at 5,500 km.
slopeFacts: Surface running route; no elevation profile is modeled.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: The path crosses from California to Maine through western, midwestern, and northeastern control points.

sourceRefs.label: AFI production notes: Maine running scenes

locationFacts: The running montage continues across several years and repeated crossings.
Forrest stops running on U.S. 163 north of Monument Valley.
deltaFacts: The chapter uses an 18,000 km cinematic distance to represent repeated crossings before the Monument Valley stop.
slopeFacts: Surface running route; no elevation profile is modeled.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: The control points keep the montage in a lower eastern-to-southwestern corridor before ending at U.S. 163.

locationFacts: After the run ends, Forrest receives Jenny's letter and travels to Savannah.
At Jenny's apartment he meets Forrest Jr. and learns Jenny is sick.
deltaFacts: The route returns from Monument Valley to Greenbow, then continues to Savannah.
slopeFacts: Surface travel across road and bus segments; no elevation or depth is modeled.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: The chapter reconnects the running route to the opening Savannah frame.

locationFacts: Jenny and Forrest Jr. move back with Forrest to Greenbow.
The film closes at the Greenbow home and school-bus stop.
deltaFacts: The final route returns from Savannah to Greenbow.
slopeFacts: Surface bus route; no elevation or depth is modeled.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: The final segment brings the route back to the fictional Alabama home anchor.
